assembly.method: Bounded existing public JSON only; no new hashes, SQL, engine/corpus reads, tests or measurements.
assembly.referencePolicy: Only publicReference/publicReferences objects designate published companion links. Other evidence/report/ledger/log/input filenames are retained source-artifact labels, not links and not a claim that private inputs accompany this publication. Labels preserve original execution provenance. Private raw inputs are not included.
assembly.qualification: Publication wrapper and explicit links are new; original execution dates, engine/index lineage and observations are preserved. Source documents are untouched.

method.sourceFallbackAdditionalPurpose: Headers, import/export lists, or declarations omitted from bounded CodeGraph results.
method.columnConvention: zero-based UTF-8 byte offset; source line numbers are one-based

ruletypes-pattern.explanation: An unrestricted unqualified RuleTypes import exposes its bundled GhcSessionDeps pattern. The expression positions refer to the value pattern declared at 530–531, not the type of the same spelling at 519. The graph represents this pattern as enum_member.

cabal-config-action.explanation: Cabal imports Development.IDE as D without qualified, so its exports remain available unqualified. Development.IDE exports module X and explicitly imports getClientConfigAction from Rules as X. Rules exports that name and imports Shake hiding only Log. Shake explicitly exports its Action Config value. Cabal’s separate Shake import selecting restartShakeSession and its qualified Shake import do not supply this bare name.

hlint-define-no-file.explanation: Hlint explicitly imports defineNoFile from Rules. Rules explicitly reexports it and imports Shake hiding only Log. Shake explicitly exports the function defined at 1266. Its lambda argument at the call site confirms ordinary application.

refactor-main-qualified.explanation: Main imports CodeAction qualified as Refactor. CodeAction explicitly exports the five descriptor functions and extractNotInScopeName. The first five sites pass descriptor function values to mkPluginTestDescriptor; the next fourteen directly apply extractNotInScopeName to text, matching references versus calls.

refactor-main-regex.explanation: Main explicitly imports matchRegExMultipleImports unqualified, and CodeAction explicitly exports it. The local template helper binds message and expected; it applies the imported function to message.

refactor-add-argument-qualified.explanation: AddArgument imports CodeAction qualified as Refactor. The exported descriptor functions are passed as values to mkPluginTestDescriptor; references edges preserve that syntax.

rename-exactprint.explanation: Rename imports CodeAction unrestricted and unqualified. CodeAction explicitly exports mkExactprintPluginDescriptor; the recorder argument and dollar application at the site match a call to the definition at 225.

rename-run-action.explanation: Rename imports Service hiding only Log, retaining runAction. Service explicitly exports runAction and defines the function at 111. All three sites apply it to a label, IDE state and an action.

rename-shake-extras.explanation: Rename imports Shake hiding only Log, retaining getShakeExtras. Shake explicitly exports this Action ShakeExtras value. At the source site it is the action argument passed to runAction, supporting references rather than a direct application edge.

hls-plugins-qualified.explanation: HlsPlugins imports CodeAction qualified as Refactor. Import and all five calls occur under the same hls_refactor CPP condition. Every descriptor is explicitly exported and applied to recorder and plugin ID. This checks the indexed source branch, not a compiled configuration matrix.

limitations: This is source-grounded review of the exact 37 additions, not an exhaustive proof of resolution precision or recall for HLS.
Public source URLs are immutable anchors derived from the recorded corpus repository and revision; they were not network-fetched during this review.
CPP sites were checked against the indexed source and matching guards, without compiling every feature configuration.
The four historical kick edges were checked for exact identity, metadata and provenance retention, without repeating the earlier source review.
Evidence applies to the named 19 September run; a later run needs graph fingerprint equality before this review can be reused.

publicReferences.role: Exact transfer to the final 20 September graphs
